package good

import "time"

type worker struct{ now func() time.Time }

func newWorker() *worker {
	return &worker{now: func() time.Time { return time.Now().UTC() }}
}

func newOther() *worker {
	return &worker{now: time.Now}
}

func (w *worker) reset() {
	w.now = time.Now
}

func (w *worker) stamp() time.Time { return w.now() }
